byte_rule: UTF-8 bytes of the canonical string; Unicode strings NFC-normalized before serialization; float values rejected (INVALID_FLOAT).
derivation_id_rule: SHA-256 over context_id + rule_id + rule_version + implementation_digest + ordered premise evidence_ids + inference rule name.
digest_rule: SHA-256, lowercase hex, 64 characters, prefixed 'sha256:'. No truncated digests in production content.

digest_vectors.unicode_note: Predicate stored NFC; NFD input must be normalized before hashing (X4 rejects unnormalized input).

field_boundary.context_note: Revision, line numbers, configuration, environment, and execution are CONTEXT, never proposition: V2 (line move), V6 (configuration broadening), and V7 (revision change) keep proposition identity with a new context. New contexts require new obligations; old satisfaction never transfers.

note: TEST-ONLY canonicalization contract. No production code is wired to this file yet. Normative per ADR-KERNEL-002.
publication_decision_id_rule: SHA-256 over derivation_id + certificate digest + gate policy version + freshness evaluation + reconciliation state.
serialization: JSON object, keys sorted lexicographically, separators (',', ':') with no whitespace, ensure_ascii=False. Only proposition_fields are serialized for PropositionID.
